title: AEGIS configuration (frozen interface F8)
description: Typed config; unknown fields rejected (deny_unknown_fields). Hard limits are schema maxima: no limit may be unbounded (INV-NONEMPTY: default boot has no effective None limit). CANON-2 per-clause reject/308/accept decided by spike q4-008. Max file size 1 MiB (CFG-2); on parse error the last-known-good config keeps serving (CFG-3).

bind.description: loopback address or unix:/path; metrics endpoint always on

canon.description: Resolved by spike q4-008 (3.27M request lines 2024-2026, per-clause benign false-reject threshold 0.1%)

encoded_non_ascii_path.description: %80-%FF octets accepted as opaque bytes; invalid UTF-8 or non-NFC after decoding still rejected

empty_segments.description: // merged and answered with 308 to the merged path; never forwarded

trailing_slash.description: /a/ is its own canonical form, distinct from /a

query.description: opaque: forwarded byte-exact, never split by the core; typed: per-route declared parameters with strict per-parameter rules (duplicates, encodings rejected)

host.description: ASCII-lowercase A-label exact match; no IDNA on ingress (CANON-6)

oneOf.description: P2 route target wasm:<module-id> (Phase 5, F14). The id must name a declared p2.modules[] entry (checked at load; a wasm route without a p2 block fails the load). The route's authz and data endowment apply unchanged: every F14 data_run is authorized against routes[].data (absent = no data capability).

authz.description: Cedar policy set name; absent means the route is denied (INV-NONEMPTY)

data.description: Data endowment of the route (F4 CapSet). Absent: the route holds no data capability and cannot reach any backend (never unrestricted). A list: CapSet::Caps, non-empty (an empty list is invalid, not 'all'). The literal "unrestricted": CapSet::Unrestricted, explicit and CI-gated (ci/unrestricted.py ledger); it lifts the capability check only (tenant conjunct, schema gate, budgets and allowlist lock still apply).
Data plane (Phase 4). Backend ids are unique; every routes[].data[].backend names a declared backend (checked at load, error otherwise).

dsn_ref.description: Where the connection target comes from; never an inline DSN or secret. env:NAME / cred:NAME (systemd credential) hold a DSN for postgres/redis/valkey; path:/abs is the SQLite database file and is valid only with engine sqlite.

pin.description: Entry in supply-chain/engine-pins.toml (F4 EnginePin) whose family must equal engine. Config selects a pin; it cannot lower a floor or unblock a major. Connect refuses a server version the pin does not admit.

max_conns.description: Pool size cap for network engines; open-handle cap for sqlite

op_budget_ms.description: Per-op budget; PG statement_timeout and NC3 T_recover

data_cap.description: One F4 DataCap. Column names are resolved against the introspected schema at boot; an unknown name fails the load.

p2.description: P2 isolation (Phase 5; F14 guest ABI and worker frames; SPEC_INVARIANTS H INV-P2). Absent: no P2 route can be configured. The cordon key is always the principal and is not configurable: no field of this block, or of any other F8 block, can name, share or merge a cordon, so a cordon shared by principals is unrepresentable (PLAN D1). Every limit is bounded and defaulted. Fuel is accounting (D6): wall_ms (epoch for a cordon, ITIMER_REAL for a fork child) is the DoS bound. Operator obligation, not a load check (p50 is unknown at load time): a module's fuel should stay <= 50x its route's p50 handler cost (q4-006). Boot refuses p2 routes (exit 78, fail closed) when the worker is missing, a module digest does not match, or Landlock ABI < 4.

worker.description: Absolute path of the aegis-p2 worker binary; every zygote, cordon and compile process is a fresh execve of it (D8 exec respawn, never a fork of a template).

cache_dir.description: Directory (0700, service user) for this boot's .cwasm files produced by the sandboxed `aegis-p2 compile`; absent = $RUNTIME_DIRECTORY/p2. Never a source of modules: a .cwasm is loaded only if its sha256 equals the digest the supervisor recorded at this boot's compile (D4).

isolation.description: Default path for multi-principal modules (D1, q4-006 flip; D23 option b): forkwasm = fork child of an exec-spawned single-threaded zygote, fresh instance per request; cordon = one exec-spawned cordon per principal, fresh instance per request; auto (the default) resolves at boot and at every reload from the usable CPU count (the process's sched_getaffinity set): fewer than 8 -> cordon (VPS-class hosts, where forkwasm oom recovery p99 missed the 5 ms gate on kamrui), otherwise forkwasm. Explicit forkwasm or cordon is used as written. Switching is a config change plus reload, no rebuild. Single-tenant modules always run in a per-principal cordon.

fuel.description: Default per-request fuel (units). Accounting budget, not the DoS bound (D6).

wall_ms.description: Default per-request wall-clock bound in ms: epoch deadline in a cordon, ITIMER_REAL in a fork child (R-ISO-3).

memory_mib.description: Default per-instance linear-memory cap in MiB (ResourceLimiter); table growth bounded by the same limiter.

max_host_calls.description: Per-request cap on F14 host calls of every kind (I2). Breach traps the request.

max_data_runs.description: Per-request cap on F14 data_run calls; also the handle-table size (I2). Breach traps the request.

max_data_bytes.description: Per-request cap on the summed encoded size of data_run ops and replies (I2). Breach traps the request.

max_resp_bytes.description: Per-request cap on response body bytes written through resp_write (I2). Breach traps the request; nothing is forwarded.

max_log_bytes.description: Per-request cap on log bytes (I2). Breach traps the request.

frame_max_bytes.description: Cap on one F14 worker<->supervisor frame (SOCK_SEQPACKET message). A larger or truncated frame is a decode failure: the worker is killed and the principal charged.

max_cordons.description: Cap on live cordons (one per principal). At the cap the least-recently-used idle cordon is reaped; when none is idle the request is refused (503), never routed to another principal's cordon.

cordon_idle_s.description: An idle cordon is reaped after this many seconds.

mpk.description: Wasmtime memory_protection_keys as a density option only (D11): reservation (4 GiB) and guard (32 MiB) are asserted unchanged with and without it; never guard shrinking (GHSA-6wgr, GHSA-394w).

modules.description: Module ids are unique (checked at load).

p2_module.description: One P2 core Wasm module (F14 ABI). Imports outside the F14 allowlist refuse the module at compile (boot exit 78; reload keeps last-known-good, CFG-3).

path.description: Absolute path of the .wasm (read-only in the worker's Landlock domain).

sha256.description: Digest of the .wasm file; a mismatch at boot or reload refuses the module.

tenancy.description: multi: runs on p2.isolation (default forkwasm). single: runs in a per-principal cordon (D1).

fuel.description: Per-module fuel override (per-route calibration); absent = p2.fuel.

p2_crash_budget.description: Per-principal crash budget (D7): `crashes` crash-attributable faults (trap, abnormal child exit, cordon death, F14 decode failure caused by that principal's request) within `window_s` => that principal's P2 requests get 429 for `penalty_s`. Healthy failures and other principals' faults never count. Minimums are low so a gate can scale the windows down.
